scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "bun run --cwd frontend dev" "bun run --cwd backend dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n dev,worker,parsing:worker,classification:worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "bun run dev" "bun run --cwd backend worker" "bun run --cwd backend parsing:worker" "bun run --cwd backend classification:worker"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd backend build && bun run --cwd frontend build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd backend typecheck && bun run --cwd frontend typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run prettier && bun run eslint && bun run typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd backend test && bun run --cwd frontend test
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n frontend-tests,backend-tests -c cyan,magenta "bun run --cwd frontend test:watch" "bun run --cwd backend test:watch"
scripts.test:coverage: bun run --cwd backend test:coverage && bun run --cwd frontend test:coverage
